track: B: causal foundation models, causal meta-learning, active acquisition and experimental design
method: Targeted web search plus backward reference chaining from primary full texts; no claim of exhaustive systematic coverage.
actual_queries: Do-PFN pretrained foundation model causal treatment effects paper
MACAL active learning causal treatment effect paper
"CausalICL" OR "causal in-context" treatment estimation foundation model
"Unveiling prior-data fitted networks on causal effect estimation"
"Meta-learning for heterogeneous treatment effect estimation with closed-form solvers"
"Frequentist Consistency of Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Causal Inference"
"Improving Treatment Effect Estimation with LLM-Based Data Augmentation"
inclusion: Primary paper, proceedings, author repository or author institution record available.
Direct causal-FM estimation or a methodological precursor relevant to frozen-context selection.
Active outcome acquisition or experimental-design work with an explicit treatment-effect objective.
Publication/version dated no later than cutoff; latest accessible version recorded.
ATE, CATE/PEHE, uplift-policy, longitudinal CAPO and structural-discovery claims kept distinct.
exclusion: Secondary AI summaries used only for discovery, not evidentiary claims: Pith, Lacuna, alphaXiv, EmergentMind, HypePaper, Paperium, PaperPeel and similar.
Unrelated educational active learning, general clinical guidance and unrelated context-stratified epidemiology search hits.
Pure causal-discovery models without a directly relevant effect-estimation/context mechanism.
Duplicates of preprint, conference and workshop versions retained as one source card.
Generic ICL, policy-learning and uplift-metric papers assigned to other review tracks.
